<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“This is Guild business, Calder. Certainly, we can always use more Readers, but we haven’t fallen so low as to recruit...men as young as yourself.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|— ''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 8}}</div></div>

''See also: [[Reader Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Readers]] are individuals capable of consciously perceiving and manipulating [[Intent]], a fundamental force found within people and objects. This discipline allows them to perform various specialized tasks, such as investigating crimes by sensing an object's history, crafting or enhancing tools, and detecting lies. While they do not possess superior intelligence or physical beauty, their ability to sense and alter [[Intent]] provides significant advantages in many fields. Some highly advanced [[Readers]], known as [[Soulbound]], can reach the pinnacle of this power to perform miraculous feats, though those who attempt to harness [[Elder powers]] instead of [[Kameira]] often face rapid insanity. A major danger associated with the practice is '[[Reader burn]],' which occurs when a person's abilities exceed their physical constitution. Furthermore, attempting to directly sense the [[Intent]] of [[Great Elders]] is a severe taboo that typically results in madness. Despite these risks, [[Readers]] play vital roles within [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]]; they serve as investigators, craftsmen, and even leaders. The Emperor is noted as the most powerful Reader in history, possessing a level of skill that allows him to manipulate [[Intent]] on a massive scale. Because of their unique abilities, [[Readers]] often exist outside standard legal constraints, as they can frequently bypass physical restraints or evade punishment through their mastery of [[Intent]].}}

required to check belongings for suspicious items.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c2">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 2</ref> While laymen often perceive them as superhuman, [[Readers]] possess the inherent advantage of sensing changes made during the investment of objects to appropriately alter their [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c4">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c6">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 6</ref> This ability includes sensing [[Intent]] through the air and even canceling it out.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c14">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c26">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 26</ref> The [[Chronicler]] is noted as a name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c15">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 23</ref> [[Readers]] serve as a position within === {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Disciplines of Reading}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Readers]] are a specific type of individual, some of whom possess the ability to lay curses for hire.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c1">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 1</ref> By definition, [[Chroniclers]] are considered talented [[Readers]], and the discipline itself involves sensing and manipulating human [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c14">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 14</ref> These individuals can consciously observe and manipulate the [[Intent]] stored within objects, a process that allows them to [[Awaken]] them.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 19</ref> Through the use of [[Reading]], they can determine information via touch, though bringing out an object's full potential requires significant strength and focus.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c7">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 7</ref> Utilizing their unique [[Reader senses]], they are proficient at investigating crimes, crafting tools and weapons, enacting subtle sabotage, or manipulating information received by other [[Readers]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c11">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 11</ref> A Reader can even feel the power of [[Nakothi's song]] directly through their senses.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c15">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 15</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Use of the Optasia}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A Reader is an individual capable of performing the act of [[Reading]], a process that allows them to use the [[Optasia]] to magnify their natural talents.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c13">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 13</ref> Through this ability, they can experience vivid visions of distant locations and perform Readings to sense [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4" /><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c11">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 11</ref> These skills enable a Reader to investigate the history of an artifact or uncover the truth behind a crime.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 14</ref> While a Reader from the [[Imperial Prisons]] was once utilized to test the [[Optasia]], some practitioners follow a custom of blinding themselves to achieve a clearer sense of [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c22">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 22</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A [[Reader]] is someone who can use the [[Optasia]] to magnify their talents.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Readers]] can experience vivid visions of other places.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A [[Reader]] is someone who can perform Readings to sense [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Readers]] are individuals who can perform the act of [[Reading]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A [[Reader]] can investigate the truth of a crime or the history of an artifact.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14" />}}</li>

</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Powers and limitations}} ===

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Awakening and identity}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A Reader must possess the capability to operate at the same level as the [[Regents]], a role that [[Tyria]] does not fulfill.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref> While a sane Reader would avoid examining [[iron-and-crystal manacles{{!}}manacles]] closely, they serve as one of the three essential sources of [[Intent]] during the [[Awakening]] process.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c16">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref> A Reader is required to verify the identity of [[Calder]], though they are instructed to avoid looking at the [[Elders]], particularly when using a looking-glass.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref> [[Calder]] relies on intuition rather than his Reader powers to sense [[Loreli]]'s intentions, especially since a Reader can be deceived if someone controls their [[Intent]] to conceal memories.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A [[Reader]] is needed who understands full capabilities and can operate on the level of the [[Regents]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Tyria]] is not a [[Reader]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|No [[Reader]] in their right mind would examine the [[iron-and-crystal manacles{{!}}manacles]] closely.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Reader]] is one of the three sources of [[Intent]] in the [[Awakening]] process.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Readers]] are taught not to look at the [[Elders]], especially with a looking-glass.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] senses [[Loreli]]'s intentions through intuition rather than his power as a [[Reader]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A [[Reader]] can be deceived by controlling one's [[Intent]] to hide memories.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Readers]] are a specific group that includes the individual known as [[Lucan]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c17">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 17</ref> Utilizing her unique Reader's awareness, [[Loreli]] is able to sense through the water.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref> During [[Shera]]'s meeting, several [[Readers]] are discovered among the [[Architects]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref> A Reader was also located in close proximity while searching for [[Loreli]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Readers]] are a group that includes [[Lucan]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Loreli]] uses her [[Reader]]'s awareness to sense through the water.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Readers]] are found among the [[Architects]] at [[Shera]]'s meeting.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Reader]] was searching for [[Loreli]] close by.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“I’ve done nothing! Committed no crime! Let me stand trial, I beg you, and I will prove my innocence!”<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“I needed a Reader that fit several criteria, including age.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c24" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“The boy’s right,” Foster said. “First thing they teach you as a Reader: don’t look at the Elders. Especially not with a looking-glass pressed right against them.”<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" />}}
